content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NHM Dharashiv Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NHM Dharashiv Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for NHM Dharashiv Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates should report as per the specified time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Super Specialist / Specialist / Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies announced for the Super Specialist / Specialist / Medical Officer positions under the National Health Mission Dharashiv.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the NHM Dharashiv posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 69 years for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Medical Officer BAMS post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Officer BAMS post is Rs. 25,000/- per month plus an additional Rs. 15,000/- as Performance Based Incentive (PBI).

faq.question: Q5. What are the required qualifications for the Specialist posts like Cardiologist and Nephrologist?
faq.answer: For Cardiologist, DM Cardiology is required. For Nephrologist, DM Nephrology is the required qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NHM Dharashiv Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 150, while SC/ST and Women candidates need to pay Rs. 100.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, followed by a Walk-in Interview, and finally, a Merit List will be prepared.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF for NHM Dharashiv Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to report for the walk-in interview between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM on the interview date.
